subject: Vendr portal API keys + S3 evidence sync — next steps
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir@vendr.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: security@vendr.com
Date: 2027-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendr API onboarding for Solstice Health — initial info

Hi Evelyn — great to meet you on the call earlier. Per our discussion, we can enable a scoped API integration so Vendr can push completed evidence artifacts (SOC2/CAIQ PDFs and CAIQ mapping sheets) directly to a customer-owned S3 bucket and also send webhook notifications on upload.

What we need from your side to get started:
- A staging S3 bucket path (bucket name + prefix) and an IAM role ARN that grants PutObject + PutObjectAcl to that prefix.
- IP ranges (CIDRs) to allowlist for webhook calls or a plan to use webhook signing (HMAC).
- A contact for long-lived key rotation cadence (we recommend 90 days).

I attached our integration guide and key-scoping instructions. I can provision a "staging-scoped" API key for initial testing that only allows file uploads and read/list on evidence metadata.

Attachments: vendr_api_integration_guide.pdf, scoped_api_key_instructions.txt

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Vendor Integrations, Vendr
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@vendr.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr API onboarding for Solstice Health — initial info

Samir — thanks, this is helpful. Looping in our security and infra leads so we can align on the minimal scope. Action items from our side:

- Lauren: can you confirm whether we should give Vendr a cross-account role or accept uploads to a customer-owned pre-signed URL flow?
- Mina: please review the webhook signing vs IP allowlist tradeoffs and confirm required headers/algorithms.
- Sergio: can you confirm SLA language we need included for retention/purge of artifacts?

Preliminary answers:
- Solstice Health prefers customer-bucket push to avoid us pulling sensitive artifacts into a central archive. Proposed staging bucket: solstice-health-evidence-staging.redwood-us-west-2.s3.amazonaws.com with prefix vendr/solstice/2027/staging.
- We'll need the scoped API key and a webhook HMAC header rather than broad IP allowlisting if possible.

I'll send the IAM/role template and the Jira ticket to track tasks.

Evelyn
Head of Platform Security (on rotation)
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Samir Khan <samir@vendr.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr API onboarding for Solstice Health — initial info

Quick technical follow-ups:

1) We prefer Vendr assuming a cross-account IAM role with the following minimal policy (I'll paste the template to the Jira ticket): PutObject, ListBucket (conditioned on prefix), PutObjectAcl. We will attach a bucket policy that restricts PutObject to the role ARN.

2) HMAC-signed webhook is our preference. Please include an X-Vendr-Signature: sha256=<hex> header and a timestamp header so we can tolerate 5min skew. Also: retry semantics — we need idempotent behavior and at least 3 retries with exponential backoff.

3) File naming & metadata: file names should include evidence type (e.g., soc2-report-YYYYMMDD.pdf), control-id, and evidence-id. We will run an automated CAIQ parser that depends on these conventions.

Samir, can you confirm whether a cross-account role is supported in your deployment model or if you only support S3 presigned URLs? If cross-account is supported, please provide the role session external ID to include in the trust policy.

Thanks,
Lauren
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Samir Khan <samir@vendr.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr API onboarding for Solstice Health — initial info

I've reviewed the integration guide and the minimal security controls we need to accept automated evidence ingestion: 

- Scoped API key OR cross-account role (scoped API key must be limited to uploads + metadata read).
- Webhook signing using HMAC-SHA256 (X-Vendr-Signature). Please provide sample signature verification steps.
- Ensure artifacts are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS depending on Solstice's retention policy).
- Key rotation: 90 days for long-lived keys; support for immediate revocation via a management endpoint.
- Audit logging: each upload must include an evidence_id and user_id in metadata to map to the CAIQ control.

Also: we need a SOC2 mapping spreadsheet for the artifacts you will upload (control -> artifact type -> retention), so we can attach each uploaded artifact to the appropriate control in our internal evidence tracker. Can you upload that mapping as a CSV in the staging prefix?

I'll concede to IP allowlisting only for initial vetting, but long term we require HMAC signed webhooks.

Mina
Manager, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Khan <samir@vendr.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: security@vendr.com
Date: 2027-05-04T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr API onboarding for Solstice Health — initial info

Thanks everyone — we can support the cross-account role flow and will provision a scoped role for Solstice with a restrictive policy. Plan & deliverables: 

- Tomorrow: provisional cross-account role ARN and trust policy (external-id: vendr-solstice-2027) for your infra to embed in the bucket policy.
- Scoped API key: we will create a "staging-upload-only" key valid for 30 days for testing.
- Webhook: we will sign with X-Vendr-Signature: sha256=<hex> using an HMAC key; we will publish the verification routine in our onboarding doc.
- We'll upload a sample SOC2 mapping CSV into the staging prefix and push the initial evidence bundle (one CAIQ JSON + one SOC2 PDF).

Links and attachments: onboarding doc: https://vendr.com/docs/api/onboarding — look at section 3 for webhook signing examples. I attached the sample integration guide for your infra team.

If you want, we can open a brief joint run (30–60 minutes) where our infra engineer walks your team through verifying signatures and testing PutObject.

Regards,
Samir Khan
Vendor Integrations, Vendr
Attachments: vendr_api_integration_guide.pdf, scoped_api_key_instructions.txt
